# Acme, with Figma's side

Laid over `acme-angular` by `test/class-parity.test.mjs`: Acme's Figma variables and component structure, which parity compares the code with. Every name is invented.

One deliberate difference: Figma's button rounds its corners with `radius-l` (8px), and the code's button uses `--acme-radius` (6px).
